en: Master Nesingwary has a big hunt ahead of him. I find helping him prepare for a day in the jungle is much more relaxing than helping him ready for combat. Although I do miss some of those glorious moments on the battlefield.
Elder Stormbrow is most likely at the village of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Winterhoof? I hear he's living it up in Booty Bay.
Last I knew, Elder Starsong was in the Sunken Temple of the Swamp of Sorrows.

Adventure from lands far and near 
Meeting with folks both odd and queer 
But if of me a question you ask 
You must first complete a simple task!

A foul corruption has crept into Westfall. While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

Another fine day in the jungle! It's going to be quite a hunt, I can feel it. Once Barnil is done cleaning the guns, I'm taking the hunting party deep into the twisting vines. Not such a bad way for an old war vet to spend his retirement, eh?
I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.
Where are you going? Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!
